svg.title: OCI Block Volume Backup Dashboards — deployed architecture
svg.desc: Native backup completion events flow through Events, Streaming and Connector Hub to Log Analytics and an Activity dashboard. An hourly read-only Function inventories the same source compartments and publishes coverage snapshots and metrics. Terraform and Python manage deployment; OCI Logging stores Function diagnostics.

g.text: Event activity + optional inventory coverage • OCI Console native dashboards
ORACLE CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE / DEPLOYMENT PROFILE REGION
Existing network • exact configured compartment scope
01 ACTIVITY / NATIVE BACKUP & COPY COMPLETION EVENTS
Root UI filters do not expand scans
Native OCI Console dashboard + saved searches
Native OCI Console dashboard + saved searches
TENANCY HOME REGION / IAM POLICIES + FUNCTION & SCHEDULE DYNAMIC GROUPS
Least privilege: scoped inventory reads, telemetry writes and scheduled invocation. Events and Connector Hub use scoped service-principal policies.
Custom fields, JSON parser and sources
Activity counts completion events. Coverage counts distinct observed volumes. Neither proves restore success or required DR-copy availability.
Solid arrows: runtime data / service access. Missing or stale data is unknown. Coverage is optional; no VM is required.
Artwork: OCI Architecture Diagram Toolkit v23.1 • Oracle
